translations.answer: The provided candidate process is to first disable Domain Randomization (DR) in an ideal environment, retaining only the most direct task reward. Once the strategy is confirmed to complete the basic objectives, specific constraints such as posture, energy, and smoothness are incrementally added. The process is still considered partial as there is no formal retraining result. The original post lacks code, curves, and platform information, so it is a methodological suggestion.
